content.comment_body: I followed the link shared by the moderator to download [product_name] [version_no], but received a message stating the document could not be found and is temporarily unavailable. I currently have [product_name] [version_no] installed, but I'm encountering issues with [product_name] [version_no] that comes with it. Although I can use [product_name] to set up the environment on AWS Elastic Beanstalk and the application loads, I end up with an HTML Error 500. I'm looking for the previous version of [product_name] [version_no] to verify if the newer version is causing the issue.
If you need an older version of [product_name], consider submitting a Support Request. The Support Team may be able to assist you.
I checked my computer downloads and found my earlier copy.

analysis.insight_summary: The user faced issues downloading a prior release of [product_name] due to a broken link, which prevented them from troubleshooting a compatibility problem with [product_name] when deploying on AWS Elastic Beanstalk. Access to the previous version was necessary to validate the cause of an HTML Error 500, and the initial inability to download it slowed down issue resolution.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect easy access to older software versions and reliable integration of software tools for AWS deployment, which supports efficient troubleshooting and quick identification of issues.
